notes.title: Bunker Punks 1.1 Release Notes
notes.content:
Bunker Punks 1.1 is live!

This is primarily a polish/balance update with a couple of bug fixes.

[b]Changes:[/b]
- The Special/Ultra Ability Icon now appears below the reticle, this will make it easier to know when you have an active ability.
- Minor balance and adjustments to Shotguns. All Shotguns do slightly less damage per shot, but fire more shots, which reduces the chances of missed shots. Effective range was also reduced slightly, making them more devastating up close, but less effective at range.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
- Some users reported slower framerates at the start of the level, we've made some changes that should address the issue.
- Fixed a bug where if you switched a weapon while charging your Plasma Cannon, your next weapon would shake as if it were charging. Also fixed minor audio issues in similar scenarios.

Big thanks to everyone for providing feedback, suggestions and bug reports.

notes.title: Bunker Punks Ver. 1.0 is here!
notes.content:
Version 1.0 is here!

The 1.0 update includes the adding the soundtrack by A Shell In The Pit as DLC, the last playable character, Null Point, balance changes and a couple of bug fixes.

For those who haven’t played the game since the Early Access launch, this is a great time to check out the game again. Additions:
- The Bunker Punks soundtrack, by A Shell In The Pit is now available as DLC.
- Bunker Punks and the soundtrack are available in a Deluxe Edition Bundle.
- Null Point has been added - he’s a heavy weapons expert who starts with a Rocket Launcher and has abilities that buff the AoE of weapons.

Changes:
- Minor balance adjustment pass across most weapons. 
- Minor balance adjustment pass across most enemies.
- GUI Clean up, adding frames to armor slots.

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed a couple of minor issues on ultra wide resolution monitors.

Finally, we would like to extend our sincere gratitude to everyone in the Bunker Punks Early Access community. Your feedback, bug hunting and support over the past two years has been instrumental in making Bunker Punks the game it is today. We couldn’t have done it without you.

notes.title: Bunker Punks 0.9.7 Katana and Shotgun Improvements
notes.content:
Bunker Punks 0.9.7 is Live!!

This update focuses on polish and balance, including a new collision system for the Katana which makes it less of a 'challenge' weapon and more usable all-around.

Changes:
- Shotguns fire more shots, but each shot does less damage. This makes mid-range shots hit most consistently.
- The Katana now uses a different collision system which checks collision along a vertical range so that it's much more usable and less of a 'challenge' weapon. Damage has been reduced slightly as well.
- UI adjustments.
- 'Corpse' sprites for Red Widow and Sentry EX are lower so they don't partially hide the pickup items that spawn when the unit dies.

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed two bugs which were preventing some enemy units from dropping pickups when they died.

- Rebalanced the Rocket Launcher so that it has less ammo, but does more damage in a smaller AoE. 
 

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed an exploit where the player could switch weapons while a weapon buff ability/ultra was active.

notes.title: Bunker Punks 0.9.5 Release Notes
notes.content:
Bunker Punks 0.9.5 is live.

This is a large update that has a mix of bug fixes, balance adjustments and playability improvements. Players will notice more gameplay variety, especially in the mid-game, more utility with pistols and a more balanced and engaging experience overall.

Extra thanks to the Bunker Punks Steam community for the bug reports. Especially the hard to track inventory issues and typos found amongst all of the dialog and loading screen text in the game.

Changes:
- Adjustments made to controller inputs and aim-assist to make the game more playable with controller.
- Autopistol does more damage per shot
- All pistols have a broader effective range, making them a mid-range weapon
- Grenade Launcher rebalanced to be more consistent
- Brutes have reduced HP and appear more frequently
- Chargers have reduced HP and appear more frequently
- Brute and Charger changes were made to improve variety in the early mid-game and reduce the changes of running out of ammo
- Put a short timer at the end of a level so that players don’t accidentally skip the post-game popup
- Adjust spread on shotguns to make them slightly more effective at mid-range
- Increase HP on Sentry and Sentry EX
- Increased min-damage on Plasma Rifle so that the uncharged shots deal more damage
- Explosion Particles adjusted to look better
- There is an explosion when the Mother dies, spawning her last drones
- Enemy types are more defined by level type, meaning that each level will have a particular play style, adding to the variety in gameplay
- Store items in the Wasteland Merchant Caravan have lighter backgrounds so that they are easier to see
- Stun laster longer on Stun Baton to encourage more players to use it


Bug Fixes:
- Numerous Door Placement bugs
- Grenade Launcher shot rolling sound no longer randomly plays forever
- Numerous grammar and spelling errors 
- Fixed problem with Punk info pop-up in the Bunker being cut off on the side of the screen on some resolutions
- Clearing high speed run achievements will now reward all of the lower achievements
- A Pistol is no longer added to the bunker inventory at the end of every raid.
- Idle Speech events no longer queue up when the game is paused (resulting in a LOT of talking when the game was unpaused - probably my favourite bug on the game so far)
- Royce Hall’s 3x Special Ability no longer reduces damage

notes.title: 0.9.4 Release Notes
notes.content:
0.9.4 is a huge update with a wide range of visual, balance and gameplay adjustments and bug fixes. 

Thanks go out to everyone in the community for reporting bugs (doors!!) and providing feedback and suggestions. We’re in the final stretch now and every bit of feedback is very much appreciated! 

Additions:

- Current difficulty appears in the Pause Menu.

Changes:

- Many level tile sets have been redesigned to have more saturation and stronger contrast to give them a stronger sci-fi feel.
- All shotguns have been completely rebalanced to be more devastating at very close range, but weaker at mid range. 
- All levels have had their lighting levels adjusted to better reflect their mood.
- Complete rebalance of enemy health and weapon damage to allow for more clarity on weapon buff benefits.
- Reduced AOE on Grenade Launcher
- Grenade Launcher grenade is now a bright self illuminated sprite to make it easier to see.
- Level Progression rebalanced to get more challenging enemies in the game sooner as well as adding more variety to the room shapes in earlier levels.
- Rebalance of which enemies appear in which room types.
- Increase the Tech Unlock cost on most items.
- Adjusted the velocity on the player movement to allow for quicker acceleration.
- Reduced the lifespan of Drops slightly so that they disappear faster.


Bug Fixes:

- Fixed multiple bugs with door placement (extra special thanks everyone who submitted bugs & seeds)
- The rolling sound from grenades no longer keeps playing after the grenade is destroyed in rare circumstances.
- The fourth room in the bunker is now unlockable and buildable.
- Rescaling of some enemy shadows so that they are the proper size.
- Enemy shadows and explosion decals are now properly pixelated.

notes.title: Bunker Punks Ver. 0.9.1 - Trading Cards and Big Balance Update
notes.content:
0.9.1 Release Notes

0.9.1 is a HUGE balance and polish update with a lot for both new and veteran players as well as implementation of Steam Trade Cards.

Additions:
- Steam Trading Cards, Badges, Emoticons and Profile Backgrounds are hooked up and ready to go.
- Character Specific Loadouts: The armor and weapons equipped to each character are saved during a game so that you can switch characters have their previous load out available. 

Changes:
- Double Turrets shoot in three shot bursts, down from four.
- Par times for Bronze, Silver and Gold bonus have been reduced.
- Backpack instructions for keyboard added to the tutorial image on the loading screen.
- Tutorial posters are mixed with regular posters on new games to allow for more of a narrative experience.
- The number of enemies on the first few levels is higher for experienced players, but is lower for new players. This makes the game more inviting for new players and keeps it engaging for experienced players.
- Full difficulty progression pass through all levels with a general increase in difficulty.
- The time window for combos has been increased by 20%.
- HP for some punks have been changed. Notable Dallas Beach has less health to make up for his One Shot Shield ability.
- Assault Shotgun damage and range reduced.
- More lighting variety on all levels types. 
- Color adjustments made to some level tiles to brighten up some duller tiles.


Bug Fixes:
- When players win a game and get the Victory achievement, all lower difficulty achievements are automatically awarded.
- When playing on Expert or Brutal difficulty, enemies that have a dash movement now dash faster instead of slower.
- The old damage overlay would no longer reactivates when picking up health.
- Backpack slots now keep track of the ammunition for each weapon stored in the backpack. This fixes a potential infinite ammo exploit.
- The Games Won counter for Steam Achievements would sometimes miss registering a win. This has been fixed.

notes.title: Bunker Punks Ver. 0.8.5
notes.content:
Bunker Punks 0.8.5 is live!

This is a HUGE balance and gameplay update. While there isn’t a lot of new content, the game balance has been changed a great deal. The overall goal was to keep the ‘Normal’ difficulty engaging for new players while providing Expert and “Brutal” difficulty for players who are more proficient at playing FPS games.

If you haven't picked up the game in a while, this is a great time to drop back in. 

Additions:
- “Brutal” difficulty added. Enemies move faster, shoot faster bullets and do more damage.

Changes:
- Health changes to all med-high Hit Point enemies. All ‘bullet sponges’ have had their Hit Points reduced to keep the game moving at a fast pace.
- Player momentum physics reduced slightly.
- Proxyman now shoots 2 shots instead of 3. The individual shots do slightly more damage.
- Early levels have less room shape variety in them, while harder levels have more variety.
- Level lighting adjustments.
- Difficulty progression from Bunker to Bunker on the map is more smoothed out.
- All difficulty levels have been rebalanced
- “No Broadcasting” poster removed from the game - this was confusing streamers and YouTube content creators. We want you to stream this game - please stream Bunker Punks!
- Chi drops have been removed as the variety of drops was overwhelming some players. Chi is now gained exclusively through destroying things and combos.
- Max AoE on Plasma Cannon reduced
- Damage on Rocket Launcher reduced. It’s now intended to be serve as a crowd control AoE style weapon.
- Enemy movement speeds have been adjusted for almost all of the enemy units.


Bug Fixes:
- Rendering error on toxic spills have been fixed.
- Rendering error on the elevator button has been fixed.

notes.title: Bunker Punks Ver. 0.8.1
notes.content:
Bunker Punks Ver. 0.8.1 Brings a whole lot of changes, tweaks and improvements to Bunker Punks with the goal of making the game more intuitive, rewarding and properly paced.

Additions:
- Joey Fit has been added to the Wasteland Merchant Caravan in the Bunker Building screen. Joey now helps you unlock new punks, increase the population of your bunker and add empty rooms.
- A RESET GAME option has been added to the Options Menu in the Main Menu. This will erase all progress and unlocked items and reset your game to that of a new player. Use this only if you have a corrupted save file or if you want to start from scratch.

Changes:
- Locked items are no longer unlocked at the end of a game. These items can now be unlocked from within the Bunker Building screen by building the room or visiting Joey Fit in the Wasteland Merchant Caravan. Items are still unlocked using Tech. 
- All weapons and amor are now unlocked on new games. 
- MouseOver popup in the Wasteland Merchant Caravan now gives more information about each store.
- Updated the layout for health in the GUI so that it is more consistent with the rest of the GUI.
- Moved the ‘close’ button on various popups to the left corner so that the GUI is more consistent.
- Changed the background to the Wasteland Merchant Caravan in the Bunker Building screen to the ‘big box store’ background.
- Prices for unlock able items have been adjusted.
- Tech drops more frequently, but gives less Tech per drop.
- When you unlock an additional bunker room, the empty room is added to your bunker.

notes.content:

- Pistol and Shotgun damage range has been adjusted so that it works as intended.
- Fixed an issue where the background wasn’t centered on the main menu.
- Fixed an issue where the screen fading to black would show the edges of the screen on high-definition monitors.

notes.title: Ver. 0.7.1 - GUI Update and More!
notes.content:
Ver. 0.7.1 is Live!

This is an update that focuses on a new GUI layout, but there are also a bunch of small polish items that we hope everyone will enjoy.

Additions:

Changes:
- Adjusted the room fixture system so that more complicated level layouts will not happen on early levels.
- Smoothed out the rate at which new enemies are introduced over the early parts of the game.
- Changed the font for the item information popup in gameplay so that it is easier to read.
- Reduced the health on the Proxyman.
- Reduced the damage from the Assault Rifle.
- When the player is hit, floating numbers no longer appear to illustrate the damage. This is now covered by the new health bar.
- GUI Layout changes to accommodate the minimap in the right corner.

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed a bug where enemies would occasionally spawn inside of doors.
- Enemies who shoot in bursts will now stop shooting if they are stunned in the middle of a burst shot.
- At the start of a level, pressing ‘Fire’ will no longer shoot the weapon as well as start the level.

notes.title: Bunker Punks Ver. 0.6.3
notes.content:
Bunker Punks Ver. 0.6.3 is live!

0.6.3 is a substantial update as it completes a lot of the work started on 0.6.0. The overarching goal of this work is to provide more variety and character for each level type and this will be the most noticeable aspect of this update.

Special thanks to the people in the community who are posting bugs on the forum. With your help we’ve fixed a few highly situational bugs. Your help is always appreciated!

Additions:
- Executive Levels - This is a new level type with a new tileset and enemy mix. Executive Levels are found in the second half of the map.

- Wood and Brick tilesets for fixtures such as stages, low walls and pedestals.

Changes:
- The way that levels are controlled on the backend has been redesigned to allow for more customization for each level. This means that the difference between level types such as Medical and Logistics is more substantial and goes beyond the tileset differences. The overall goal is to reduce repetitive gameplay, particularly in the later levels. This is the first pass at balancing this new system, so balance may be a little off and any feedback is welcome.

- Some room fixtures will not appear in the last room of the level as they make level-boss battles too easy.

- Increased the speed on the Brute’s rocket projectile and decreased the damage slightly.

- Increased the contrast between floors and walls to help make it easier to see hallways.

- Increased the health on Double Turrets and Charger.

Bug Fixes:
- Head Bob is defaulted to 'On' when starting a new game

- When upgrades change the max health of punks, their correct max health now appears in the Doc Mercy healing interface.

- Fixed two bugs where equipped items disappeared from the inventory if the player quits the game from the Bunker Building part of the game.

- Homing Rifle now gets the proper bonus for Rifle Buffs.

- Fixed small bugs in the stun animations of various enemies.

- Fixed a bug where the backpack GUI wouldn’t sit properly in the corner on all screen resolutions

notes.title: Ver. 0.6 - New Level Generation and More
notes.content:

Additions:
- New level building systems implemented. Players will notice a large increase in the variety of rooms as well the addition of some verticality within the rooms themselves. This is the first implementation of the new system and more variety will be added over the next updates. This also makes the levels harder to navigate and players can expect a mini-map to be implemented in an upcoming update.

- Homing Rifle: A new rifle weapon which fires a single homing round which tracks towards the closest enemy it can see. 

- Stun Baton: Shocks all nearby enemies on-screen and stuns them. Combos great with shotgun, pistol and other melee weapons.

- Cleopatra Rex, Royce Hall and Kassidee have idle VO prompts which will play if they don’t do anything for 15+ seconds.

- New background art for the Wasteland Merchants when they are visited from the Bunker Building. This is to prevent confusion with the Wasteland Merchants players visit when the game ends.

Changes:
- Level bosses no longer spawn in the middle of the last room on a floor.

- The last room on a floor can now have pillars and other fixtures.

- AI pathfinding improvements lets AI strafe to the side to go around pillars and corners.

- Alert noise for the Roller Bomb has been changed to be easier to hear.

- Main Menu has new Bunker Punks logo.

- Cleopatra Rex Special Attack stun time has been cut in half, it was too easy to abuse.

- Bullet Bea’s starting inventory has been increased to 2 weapons and 4 pieces of amor to allow for more options.

- Proxyman shoots single shots instead of bursts to make Royce Hall’s passive ability more useful.

- Proxyman health has been increased for balance.

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed issue some players were experiencing where they were unable to use the Backpack with a keyboard.

- Enemy stun animations now play consistently.

Known Issues:
- Sometimes posters on the wall will be cut off by other walls. This is a product of the new level building system and will be addressed in future builds.

notes.title: Three New Guns and More in Bunker Punks Ver. 0.5
notes.content:
[b]Bunker Punks Ver. 0.5 is live!![/b]

Three new guns and a bunch of different level decoration objects have been added as well as some small UI adjustments and bug fixes.

[b]Additions:[/b]

[b]AutoPistol: [/b]This is your bullet hose. It’s not accurate and not too great at range, but if you use it in short bursts it can really help thin out a crowd of drones.

[b]Sawed Off Shotgun: [/b]The most damaging of the shotguns. Up close, it can chew up a Proxyman in one shot, at a distance it can clear out a group of drones with a spray of buckshot. It’s slow to reload, so pick your shots carefully.

[b]Plasma Cannon: [/b]A quick tap of the fire button sends off a shot, but you can hold it down and increase the size, AoE and damage of the shot. It has very little ammo, so be selective when firing off shots.

[b]Level Decoration:[/b] Every level type has at least two new world objects, ranging from batteries and gas containers to potted plants and TV stands.

[b]Toxic Acid: [/b]Proxyman vats and toxic barrels will leak toxic acid which will hurt you if you run through it. We aware, that blue goop on the floor isn’t just for looks anymore.

[b]Changes:[/b]

- Louder alert noise for the RollerBomb, so it’s less likely to sneak up and surprise you.
- Players can turn off Head bob in the Pause Menu.
- One backpack slot is unlocked on new games, regardless of whether you’ve unlocked the Packrat upgrade.
- The default weapon of each punk in the gang is no longer automatically added to inventory.
- Enemies do 2x damage instead of 1.3x damage in Hard Mode.
- Players can now remap the “Interact” button on the keyboard.

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]

- Enemies don’t stop shooting if they’ve been stunned.
- Buildout Popup is no longer bypassed if all of your loot has been purchased at the Wasteland Merchants.
- Post-level popup has been reformatted to fit ultra-wide resolutions.
- Multiple small fixes to bugs related to controller inputs in menus.
- Holding a button down on the controller to drop loot from your backpack has consistent timing.
- Speech doesn’t play when you press the ‘4’ key on the keyboard.
- Mouse is re-aquired properly when Alt-Tab is used in windowed mode.

notes.title: Version 0.4 - Backpack, Loot store, Healing and more!
notes.content:
Bunker Punks Version 0.4 is live!

This is a very large update and changes a lot of how the macro game of Bunker Punks plays out.

The first change is the ability to take loot back to your bunker and sell it by visiting the Wasteland Merchant Caravan.

The other big change is that punks no longer heal when you finish a raid. Damage is persistent and must be healed with visits to Doc Mercy, with pickups or with upgrades to your bunker.  You will want to rest your punks so that they can recover while others do the fighting.

[b]Additions:[/b]

Backpack (available after unlocking Pack Rat upgrade)
- You can now take extra gear back to the bunker by stashing it in your backpack.
- Use the backpack by pressing 1-4 to store and holding down that key to drop any loot in that slot.
- On controller, press the “Backpack” key to choose a slot and hold it down to stash the loot

Pack Rat Bunker Upgrade
- Increase the number of slots in your backpack by building the “Packrat” upgrade in your bunker.

Pharmacy Bunker Upgrade
- Punks will heal back at the bunker while you are doing a raid.

Wasteland Merchant Caravan
- You can now visit the Caravan from your bunker. But instead of unlocking items with Tech, you can spend your creds.
- Bullet Bea: Visit Bea if you want to buy or sell weapons or amor. She drives a mean bargain, but you never know what kind of loot you’ll be able to find.
- Doc Mercy: Doc will heal your punks and get them ready for the next raid.

[b]Changes: [/b]
- Sprinting has been removed.
- Chests appear in half of the rooms instead of in every room, making loot more rare.
- Punks no longer heal damage when they complete a raid.
- Punks heal 5 points of damage during a raid. This can be increased by building the Pharmacy Upgrade
- Spider Walker bursts are shorter, but do more damage
- Tech stops being dropped if you have unlocked everything from the Wasteland Merchant Caravan
- Molly Pop’s “Step Back” ability stuns enemies for a shorter amount of time
- Weapon stun times reduced for most weapons
- Double Click window on Ultra abilities has been reduced
- Bunker no longer removes duplicates when you bring loot back to the bunker
- Reduced Kassidee’s max Health from 75 to 45 to compensate for her healing abilities
- Reduced random Spread on Assault Rifle
- Increased min-hallway width

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
- All GUI elements are deactivated when the player dies.
- Fixed bug with projectile spawn locations on enemies
- Reduced chances of enemies shooting into the wall while trying to hit the player

notes.title: Bunker Punks Ver 0.2.8 Release Notes - Big Balance Update
notes.content:
Bunker Punks Ver 0.2.8 is live!

This a a big balance update to help reward different styles of playing, tune the difficulty curve and rebalance weapons.

Additions:
- Bonus Creds are awarded at the end of a level for completing the level within a specific time (Gold, Silver or Bronze bonuses)
- Bonus Creds are awarded at the end of a level for killing every enemy on that level

Changes:

The number of enemies in the first room on a floor has been increased slightly.

Enemies
- Health increased on Proxyman
- Health, Speed and Damage increased on Pacifier
- Health increased on HoverDrone
- Health, Speed and Damage increased on RollerDrone
- Health reduced on Charger

Weapons
- Damage reduced on Hunting Rifle
- Damage reduced on Assault Rifle
- Damage reduced on Rocket Launcher
- Damage reduced on 50 Cal Mag.
- Grenade Launcher physics adjusted so that it feels better and is more predictable


Level Progression
- Changed some bunkers from 3 floor bunkers to 2 floor bunkers
- Adjusted the difficulty rank given to each bunker
- Changed when some enemies spawned in difficulty progression

There is a thread on the Steam Forum to discuss the balance changes and make recommendations. After playing the build, we’d love to hear what you think.

notes.title: Bunker Punks Ver. 0.2.2 Release Notes
notes.content:
Bunker Punks Version 0.2.2 is now live.

Additions:
- Difficulty Settings added: Easy, Normal and Hard.

- Hitboxes on the Brute and SpiderWalker were adjusted for more consistent collision detection.
- Fixed a bug where the procedural level generation dug out a corner in a room, creating a non-accessible doorway.
- Fixed a bug where the Assassin’s Sight was being dropped instead of the Doctor’s Mask.

notes.title: Bunker Punks Ver. 0.1.17 Release Notes
notes.content:
Bunker Punks Version 0.1.17 is now live.

This update includes a variety of game engine changes, bug fixes and balance changes.

Major Changes: 
- The game engine was updated from Unity 4.x to Unity 5.x. 
	Note: this may cause new issues in performance and usability. Please report any bugs on the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/446120/discussions/0/]Bunker Punks Steam Discussion board [/url]

Minor Changes:
- Drops bounce up and down slowly to make them easier to see.
- More variety in hallway width.
- More variety in level lighting colors and intensity.

Balance Changes:
- More items/armor are unlocked on a new game.
- Some armor and items are more likely to drop.
- Armor values for many items have been reduced.
- Armor and weapons drop with different frequency depending on the current difficulty level/level type.


Bug Fixes
- Player can no longer bring up the pause menu at the end of a level.
- When the player dies, the camera should no longer fall through the world.
- Player will not trigger chests on the other side of a wall.
- Baseball bat no longer works through walls.
- Health/Damage rounding errors are fixed.
- Hunters Bracers give the correct bonus in the Equip Panel.
- Enemies killed with a recently picked up explosive type weapon drop ammo.

Coming up in Version 0.1.18:
- A much larger variety of items/armor to find and use.

Coming up soon:
- More environment variety in room shape, layout, tilesets and obstacles (pillars, etc)

notes.content:

- Chests will occasionally drop consumable items.

- Ambient and dynamic lighting improvements

- A&D keys don’t change mouse sensitivity after the pause menu has been dismissed
- Player doesn’t jump upon landing if they pressed jump while in the air.
- Credits exit after they are finished scrolling.
- Errors with Rifle buff on the Hunters Cap have been fixed
- Nano Implants buff now gets reset on new game
- Sprinting buff now gets reset on new game
- Supported screen resolutions should now appear in the Options Menu
- Enemy projectile explosions no longer deal damage to enemies.
- Music volume adjustments in the pause menu now carry over to other screens
- The mouse should no longer drift if the player has a controller plugged in.

tags.feature: - Y Axis Sensitivity slider added to the pause menu

tags.bug: - Character doesn’t ‘hurt breath’ constantly when low on health. They new breath for a few seconds and stop.

tags.feature: - Chests will occasionally drop consumable items.
- Level Seed ID now appears in Pause Menu - please use this for reporting level generation bugs.

tags.balance_change: - Effective range of pistols extended slightly

tags.bug: - Brutes and Chargers should no longer appear in the first room of a level.
- Gunslinger boots have correct icon in the Bunker
- A&D keys don’t change mouse sensitivity after the pause menu has been dismissed
- Player doesn’t jump upon landing if they pressed jump while in the air.
- Credits exit after they are finished scrolling.
- Errors with Rifle buff on the Hunters Cap have been fixed
- Nano Implants buff now gets reset on new game
- Sprinting buff now gets reset on new game

tags.feature: - Supported screen resolutions should now appear in the Options Menu

tags.bug: - Enemy projectile explosions no longer deal damage to enemies.
- Music volume adjustments in the pause menu now carry over to other screens
- The mouse should no longer drift if the player has a controller plugged in.

notes.title: Bunker Punks Hotfix - Ver. 0.115.5 Now live
notes.content:
Version 0.115.5 has just been posted. This is a hotfix to address the 'Hunting Rifle' bug and a few other small fixes were added.

Bug Fixes:
- Hunting Rifle no longer causes errors when used at the end of a level
- Pause menu no longer overlaps on 4K monitors
- Comparing weapons with same damage does not make the pickup text look green.
- Bottom right side bunker can be attacked on all maps.
- Assault Armor has the correct icon in the Equip Popup.
- Notification text takes slightly longer to fade away.
